invented: many bits are overlaid in time so the waveform resembles an “eye”
The more open the eye, the more timing and voltage margin the receiver has
Key readouts include eye height voltage margin and eye width timing margin
For PCIe, the measurable “eye opening” is expressed as eye height and eye width after equalization
A PCIe redriver output must meet or exceed the listed eye-opening values
